aiResearchSummary.text: Class Technologies is researching methods to provide a remote classroom experience, as described in 'Virtual classroom with remote class features,' which details delivering video feeds of virtual classrooms and breakout groups to client devices. 'Virtual classroom over a group meeting platform' focuses on merging data feeds from multiple participants into a group presentation for group meetings. These efforts highlight development in virtual classroom integration and group collaboration features.
